name: Kiq (Gi form)
look: Kiq with a mane of white-teal frost fur, icicles at its hips, a black star mask round piercing yellow eyes, a teal-panelled black tunic and long icy belt tails streaming behind
entry: A Kiq that has earned the Master's Gi. Its kicks are so fast the air freezes in their wake; frost grows over its shoulders, and icicles over its hips.
how: Use a Master's Gi on a Kiq (it unlocks the Evolve button). It learns Frost Roundhouse when it changes.
Master's Gi: crafted from six White Wool, a Gold Ingot, a Black Belt and a Diamond, or found in dojo chests.
